title: Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI) Could Be 93% Overvalued As Amazon Deal Lifts Revenue Hopes
title_zh: 亚马逊交易提升收入希望，应用光电 (AAOI) 估值可能被高估 93%
summary: Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI) is in focus after a multi-year supply agreement with Amazon, fresh third quarter 2026 revenue guidance, and second quarter earnings that highlighted higher sales alongside continued net losses. See our latest analysis for Applied Optoelectronics.
summary_zh: 在与亚马逊签订多年供应协议、新的 2026 年第三季度收入指引以及第二季度收益（突显销售额增长和持续净亏损的同时）之后，应用光电子 (AAOI) 成为人们关注的焦点。请参阅我们对应用光电子学的最新分析。

title: What Does JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Olympic Deal And Banking Exit Mean Now?
title_zh: 摩根大通（JPM）奥运交易和银行业退出现在意味着什么？
summary: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) has been named the first global banking partner of the Olympic and Paralympic Games, marking a new worldwide sponsorship role for the bank.
summary_zh: 摩根大通（纽约证券交易所股票代码：JPM）被任命为奥运会和残奥会的首个全球银行合作伙伴，标志着该银行在全球范围内担任新的赞助商。

title: JPMorgan Resets Knicks Valuation After Lakers Deal
title_zh: 湖人交易后摩根大通重置尼克斯估值
summary: Private buyers may be exposing a major sports-stock discount
summary_zh: 私人买家可能会面临体育股票的重大折扣

title: Goldman Sachs courts investors for Nvidia $500B AI financing deal
title_zh: 高盛为 Nvidia 500B 美元人工智能融资交易吸引投资者
summary: U.S. insurers, money managers, and banks are expected to form the core investor base for the deal, which Nvidia announced earlier this week
summary_zh: 英伟达本周早些时候宣布，美国保险公司、基金管理公司和银行预计将成为此次交易的核心投资者基础

title: AMD to Raise as Much as $5 Billion From Debt Offering
title_zh: AMD 将通过发债筹集高达 50 亿美元
summary: Advanced Micro Devices Inc. is planning to raise as much $5 billion in what could be the chipmaker’s biggest-ever investment-grade bond sale, adding to a wave of debt tied to the artificial intelligence boom.
summary_zh: Advanced Micro Devices Inc. 计划筹集多达 50 亿美元，这可能是该芯片制造商有史以来规模最大的投资级债券发行，增加了与人工智能热潮相关的债务浪潮。
